conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for capital preservation with a target of ~1.5% per month. It significantly de-risks the portfolio by cutting leveraged ETFs and reducing concentration. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns, but also more modest growth potential.

balanced.read: This balanced plan prioritizes risk-first growth, targeting ~2.5% per month. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while blending broad index exposure with quality tech and some new, strong setups. Expect moderate growth with controlled drawdowns.

plan: Add to SOXL and SPAL, targeting 6% each, to increase leveraged ETF exposure for aggressive growth.
Trim SPY to 25% to address concentration and meet the single name mandate.

aggressive.read: This aggressive growth plan targets ~4% per month by leaning into leveraged ETFs and high-scoring scanner setups. This approach significantly raises both upside potential and drawdown risk, with leveraged ETFs subject to daily decay. Strict stop discipline is crucial to manage potential rapid losses.

plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure, aligning with income focus.

income.read: This income plan aims for steady monthly distributions, targeting ~1% per month, by rotating into income-focused ETFs.
